audit_timing.interpretation: Wall time for read-only hashes, parsing, independent arithmetic/RNG checks, and statistics; not pure compute.

producer_timing_interpretation: Measured wall and accounting-subtracted labels only; no pure-compute claim.

producer_timing_labels_as_recorded.interpretation: raw wall durations overlap measured serialization counters; accounting-excluded estimator time subtracts only measured ledger accounting

rng_after_verification_method: independent PCG64 SeedSequence construction followed by PCG64.advance(n); no oracle calls

statistics.pde_interpretation: Each scalar-surrogate RMS r maps to [max(0,r-1/32),r+1/32] by the conventional PDE bias statement; this is not an actual PDE solve or a floating-point enclosure.

pooled_cells.pooling_rule: math.fsum of every raw squared error across seeds, divided by pooled count, then sqrt
